name: Taco Soup
summary: Ground beef, beans, corn, and canned tomatoes simmered with taco spices. One of the most-saved recipes on Pinterest and Reddit for years, and it's obvious why.
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it apart, until browned — about 8 minutes. Drain excess fat.
Add the onion. Cook 3–4 minutes until softened.
Add garlic, chili powder, cumin, paprika, and garlic powder. Cook 1 minute, stirring.
Add the diced tomatoes, beans, corn, and broth. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 15 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve with optional toppings: sour cream, shredded cheddar, crushed tortilla chips, green onions.

glutenFree.notes: All ingredients are naturally gluten-free. Check the broth label — some broths contain gluten. Use a certified GF broth or substitute water with an extra pinch of salt.

budgetNotes: Lean ground beef at $20/kg is expensive. Regular ground beef at $18/kg works fine — just drain more fat after browning. Saves about $0.70 total.
350 g of beef feeds four people here because the beans carry the bulk. Do not skip the beans.
This freezes very well. Make a double batch and freeze in portions for the week.
Toppings (sour cream, cheese, chips) are not included in the cost. The soup is complete without them.

pricingMetadata.notes: Prices verified at Ottawa No Frills, May 2026. Lean ground beef $20.00/kg (Butcher's Choice 450g pkg at $9.00). Kidney beans $1.50/540mL can. Corn $1.25/341mL can. Diced tomatoes $2.00/796mL can. Onion $1.23 each. Garlic $0.08/clove. Broth $1.50/900mL carton (500mL = $0.83).
